subject: Order form line-item reorg and consolidation plan
messages:
From: Emma Turner <emma.turner@kestralhealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@kestralhealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request to consolidate order-form line items + scope note

Evelyn —

Thanks for the demo last week. Kestral's procurement asked me to see whether we can simplify the order form before routing to legal. We currently have three separate throughput SKUs (API-100k, API-500k, API-annual-burst) listed as distinct line items. That creates awkward procurement approvals on our side.

Request: can Redwood consolidate those into a single "API Throughput (consolidated)" line with per-token tiers and an annual volume commitment? We'd also like a one-line SOW edit that clarifies: (a) who owns the KV cache eviction policy for our tenant, and (b) an alignment on 13-month retention for audit logs (we can provide justification).

Attached is a simple spreadsheet that maps our existing PO to the consolidated view. Ideally we'd get a redline and an expected timeline for internal approvals. Also, we may need a modest commercial concession if the consolidation increases our committed spend pattern. Can you advise next steps and who from Redwood legal should expect to review?

Thanks,
Emma Turner
Senior Procurement Manager — Kestral Health
Attachments: Kestral-Requested-LineItems.xlsx

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Emma Turner <emma.turner@kestralhealth.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-09T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to consolidate order-form line items + scope note

Emma — thanks for the clear ask and the spreadsheet. We can absolutely produce a consolidated order form and a short SOW edit that captures the KV cache ownership and the log retention you requested.

Immediate plan:
- Priya (cc) will put together a commercial proposal that shows: consolidated SKU, tiered per-token pricing, and the impact to committed spend.
- Markus (cc) will intake the legal redline and propose MSA/order-form language for retention and operational responsibilities.
- I'll own delivery of a tracked-changes order form and a short change-order document for your procurement team.

Can you confirm the expected procurement approval window on your side (target sign by 2026-09-20?) and whether the SOC 2 artifacts will be routed to our security portal or attached to the PO? Once I have that, we can aim to return a redline + commercial term sheet by EOD 2026-09-11.

Evelyn Hart
Head of Customer Success — Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0192

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Emma Turner <emma.turner@kestralhealth.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-10T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to consolidate order-form line items + scope note

Emma / team —

I reviewed the high-level ask and the spreadsheet. To make the consolidation work cleanly from a contracting perspective I have a few items we'll need you to confirm so I can draft tracked changes: 

1) MSA references — is the order form currently attached to an active MSA? If yes, please confirm the MSA date/version. That tells me whether we should reference the existing "Throughput SKU" schedule or add a new one.
2) Retention & audit logs — you propose 13 months. We typically offer 12 months by default. If Kestral needs 13 months of logs, we need to capture (a) the retention period, (b) who initiates e-discovery requests, and (c) an estimated size for retention billing (so commercial can add a charge if material).
3) KV cache ownership — propose the SOW state: "Redwood operates the runtime and cache; customer may provide eviction hints via API; change-control for cache behavior requires mutual agreement." If that fits, we'll add it as a single paragraph in the SOW.
4) Indemnity / data residency — confirm whether Kestral requires any stronger data residency or additional indemnities beyond our standard MSA; if so flag now.

If you can answer 1–4 I will draft a redline of the order form and a 1-page change-order that can attach to your PO. Please send any existing MSA PDF to legal@redwood.com or attach here.

I will attach our suggested redline for your review (stub: Kestral-Redline_v1.docx).

Regards,
Markus Klein
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference
Attachment: Kestral-Redline_v1.docx

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Emma Turner <emma.turner@kestralhealth.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-11T11:34:00-07:00
Subject: Commercial proposal for consolidated SKU (DL-2026-1098)

Emma — quick commercial note to support Markus's redline. Below is the proposed pricing and implementation ask. This is intentionally conservative so procurement has clarity.

Proposed commercial terms (summary):
- Consolidated SKU: "API Throughput (consolidated)" with tiered bands: 0–250k tokens, 250–1M, 1M+ (per-token pricing detailed in attached spreadsheet).
- Annual commitment: $360,000 (equivalent to current blended forecast) — keeps your current unit economics.
- Consolidation discount: 6% off list for committing to the consolidated SKU across the 12-month term.
- One-time migration fee: $6,000 (covers order-form rework + implementation).
- If Kestral insists on 13-month log retention, we'll propose a small incremental fee (est. $500/mo) — will finalize after you confirm retention storage estimate.

Next steps: I've uploaded a provisional order form with these prices here and started a DocuSign envelope for an interim sign (link below). We can revise fields after legal finalizes redlines.

DocuSign (provisional): https://www.docusign.net/temporary/keystage/1234
Attachment: Proposed-OrderForm_20260911.xlsx

Priya Natarajan
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

From: Emma Turner <emma.turner@kestralhealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@kestralhealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-13T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Order form line-item reorg and consolidation plan

All —

Thanks, everyone. This looks aligned to our intent. Quick answers:
1) MSA: we are on MSA v2.1 (signed 2025-11-02). I'll attach the PDF shortly to this thread.
2) Retention: Kestral's security team confirmed the 13-month ask is non-negotiable due to our internal audit schedule. Expected storage impact is small — I'll share an estimate by EOD 2026-09-14.
3) No additional indemnity requirements beyond the standard MSA.

Procurement target: if we can get a redline by EOD 2026-09-14 and commercial T&Cs in-place, our procurement lead can route the consolidated order for approval on 2026-09-16. We'll then need SOC 2 evidence attached before execution.

Please expedite the tracked-changes order form; Priya, if you can populate the DocuSign envelope with the provisional pricing and mark the retention line as a chargeable item pending Markus's final language, that would be ideal.

Emma Turner
Senior Procurement Manager — Kestral Health
